notes: SR114 Made.com NL redirects (301x3, confirmed via curl_cffi safari15_3 history) to https://www.nextdirect.com/nl/nl/brands/madecom - Made exists only as a brand-filter facet (brand:madecom) inside Next's general Homeware department, not a standalone Made storefront (same platform/situation as SR48 Made.com UK, but more diminished - no dedicated made.com domain presence at all). Brand catalogue totals 139 products (department:homeware facet c:139, up from 94 at the prior Home-Decor pass date - normal catalogue drift). Investigated the page's own embedded search/facets JSON (search.filters) for a bestseller/popularity facet: the only 'feat' facet group contains exactly two values, feat:newin (Nieuw, c:19) and feat:sale (Opruiming, c:2) - no feat:bestseller, feat:popular, or any similar facet exists. Confirmed by directly requesting fabricated facet URLs /f/feat-bestseller and /f/feat-popular - both return totalResults:0 (i.e. the facet value does not exist server-side, not a genuine empty listing). The catalogue does expose a SORT option 'Meest populair' (Most Popular, sort=popular) but this only re-orders the full undifferentiated 139-product brand catalogue - it is not a distinct filtered listing of bestselling products and does not change totalResults (still 139), so it fails the brief's PLP test (not a genuine merchandising concept, just a sort order on the whole catalogue). No 'Bestsellers'/'Best Sellers'/'Meest verkocht'/'Populair' nav item, landing page, or dedicated facet found anywhere in the brand's search/filter JSON. This matches the SR48 Made.com UK finding (no genuine Bestsellers concept) and extends it: this NL locale isn't even a separate Made storefront, so there is even less surface for a bestsellers concept to exist on. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists for Made.com NL.
